newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo naphtha firms with European lots factored in.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo naphtha firms with European lots factored in.

text.p: The Tokyo naphtha market recovered on Wednesday from the initial impact of European cargoes shipped to Asia for short-covering, traders said.
"The cargoes from the West had a significant impact, but now it seems to have been factored in (by the market)," one trader said.
The naphtha market was under pressure late last week and earlier this week in anticipation of some 150,000 to 200,000 tonnes of European cargoes brought to Asia for April delivery.
Bids for first-half May open-spec naphtha were heard at $221.00 per tonne, while offers were assessed $2.00 higher.
